card.statement: [<<cite:E2>>,Remark 3.9] Let $\psi:\hh_A \to \CC$ be a linear map satisfying $\psi(\hh' \otimes I) = 0$ for some co-finite ideal $I$ of $A$. Then $(\gg' \otimes I) V(\psi)= 0$.
card.label: Lemma 3.10

paper.title: Representations of Loop Kac-Moody Lie Algebras
paper.abstract: We study representations of the Loop Kac-Moody Lie algebra g \otimes A, where g is any Kac-Moody algebra and A is a ring of Laurent polynomials in n commuting variables. In particular, we study representations with finite dimensional weight spaces and their graded versions. When we specialize g to be a finite dimensional or affine Lie algebra we obtain modules for toroidal Lie algebras.
